title: Proportional shading limit where the neighbour's northern boundary is shared by several lots
text: Where an adjoining property shares a northern lot boundary with more than one lot including the development site, the limit of shading at C3.8.1 shall be cumulative and proportional to the length of the shared boundary/ies of the development site (refer Figure 3.8f). This does not apply to diagonally adjacent lots.
notes: from: ch3 C3.9.4 (renumbered C3.8.3). Applicant states that the shadow is within the Table 3.8a limit scaled by the share of the neighbour's northern boundary the site abuts (Figure 3.8f). Not computed by the engine. Does not apply to diagonally adjacent lots.

verified.note: Wording confirmed; applicant-stated yes/no (Figure 3.8f example: R20 Lot D 25% split 15/5/5).
